protocol.split_rule: sort video IDs by SHA256(class-gate-v1:VIDEO); first floor(0.70*N) expert, next floor(0.15*N) gate, remaining development
protocol.expert_loss: original focal gamma=2 with original fixed class alphas, shared across matched baselines
protocol.gate_loss: mean binary cross entropy before YOLO confidence plus lambda*mean squared class-logit deviation from frozen global logit
protocol.selection_metric: triplet mean AP on held-out development cached crop rows; all 86 classes, zero-positive classes AP=0; NOT detection f-mAP
protocol.final_metric: unchanged baseline frame-AP at IoU 0.5 on the 36717-frame manifest and identical YOLO candidates
protocol.fitting_rows: inherited GT-positive + random-background + YOLO-junk-negative cached training crops
protocol.fitting_limit: gate fitting/development do not use full YOLO-positive candidate crops; final evaluation does
protocol.resources: CPU preflight; 3 training seeds capped at 2 priority H200 jobs; 3 evaluation seeds capped at 2 CPU jobs; afterok dependencies
protocol.prior_validation_exposure: Official validation previously informed the gate hypothesis through diagnostics; no final-evaluation tuning within this run and no claim of a fresh blind test.
